Hierarchical Procrustes pooling

Source: R/pool.R
hierarchical_pool.Rd

Pools the leading k-dimensional subspaces separately for every k = 1, ..., q. Each subspace is aligned to a medoid reference before averaging, which avoids forcing a single compromise basis to serve all dimensions.

Usage

hierarchical_pool(
  bases,
  q = 10L,
  ref = "medoid",
  iterations = 1L,
  data = NULL,
  robust = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

bases

A list of matrices or bp_basis objects.

q

Maximum number of components.

ref

Reference rule: "medoid" (default) or an integer index. The medoid is computed once in the full q-dimensional subspace and the same reference record is used for every dimension.

iterations

Number of GPA iterations for each subspace.

data

Optional list of beat matrices used to order components.

robust

Use robust reweighting.

...

Passed to [pool_bases()].

Value

A list of class bp_hpool with one bp_pool object per dimension.
